Both may lock the camera. Arthouse uses duration and empty air, even if the still is imperfect. Photography wants a picture that could hang: posed light, a chosen moment. One waits. The other composes.

When the beat is a still: a portrait, a landscape plate, a candlelit tableau. Skip it for hunting vérité, for jump-cut streets, or for empty holds that refuse to compose.

entries.title: Stylistic Suck
entries.text:
Stylistic Suck

Stylistic suck is deliberate amateur cinematography: hunting zooms, cheap video, and the wrong white balance as a choice of the film's own camera, not necessarily of a character's recovered tape. Polish would be dishonest, so the image is ugly on purpose.

Volume

Create this Stylistic Suck

Narrative function

Auto-exposure pumps. A zoom overshoots a face.

Fluorescent kitchens go green. Highlights blow like 1990s VHS.

The film is allowed to look poorly made because that look is the argument: poverty, joke, cruelty, or anti-beauty. It overlaps Found Footage but is not the same.

Found footage needs a diegetic operator and a tape story. Stylistic suck can be omniscient and still ugly: no timestamp required.

It also overlaps Cinéma Vérité, but vérité hunts in order to witness. Suck hunts in order to fail, as style.

How it works

Consumer camcorder or VHS: auto gain, hunting zoom, rolling shutter, blown practicals, wrong WB left wrong. Allow bad centering.

Do not 'fix' in the grade. If you add a pretty close-up, you have broken the contract.

Prompt deliberate amateur look, bad zoom, cheap video, the wrong white balance as a choice.

When to use it

Use it when polish would be dishonest. Do not use it as accidental incompetence, and do not use it as found footage without an operator story.

Compared with similar shots

Stylistic Suck is the film choosing ugliness. Found Footage is a character's recorder.

Cinéma Vérité is available-light witnessing. Documentary may still be respectful and sharp.

If there is a timestamp and a diegetic reason the camera exists, you are in found footage. If the ugliness is the film's voice, you are here.

Found FootageThe operator is in danger too.

Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda.

Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.

In film

The Blair Witch Project (amateur optics; also found footage, so use it as overlap, not as the whole definition). Trash Humpers (VHS, blown highlights, ugliness as the work).

Grammar, not frames to copy.

Prompt it

Deliberate amateur look on [Subject], hunting zoom, cheap video, wrong white balance as a choice, blown practicals, bad centering. Do not add a timestamp unless there is also a diegetic camera.

Do not correct the color.

Use in Image Generator

Deliberate amateur look on [Subject], bad zoom, cheap video, the wrong white balance as a choice.

What usually goes wrong

The usual wrong cousin is Found Footage: you add a timestamp and an operator without meaning to. The tell is a recovered-tape premise you did not want, or a pretty backup angle.

Fix: keep the film's camera ugly and omniscient, or commit fully to a diegetic device if that is the story.

Questions

What is Stylistic Suck in film?

A chosen amateur look: hunting zooms, cheap video, wrong white balance, blown highlights. The film's own camera refuses polish. It does not require a recovered-tape story.

Stylistic Suck vs Found Footage

Found footage needs a diegetic recorder and a reason the tape exists. Stylistic suck can be the movie looking poorly made with no operator character. Blair Witch is both. Trash Humpers is suck as voice.

When should I use Stylistic Suck?

When polish would lie. Skip it if you need a recovered-camera plot, if you need vérité respect, or if a single pretty angle would sneak back in.

entries.title: Video Game
entries.text:
Video Game

Video game cinematography uses playable camera logic: a follow cam, an isometric view, or an FPS eyeline, with space readable as a level and a HUD implied. Collision, boom height, and pathing constrain the lens the way a game engine would.

Volume

Create this Video Game

Narrative function

The world is playable. A character moves and the camera booms behind at a fixed height, or the map is seen at 45 degrees, or we look through a reticle.

Collectible space, ledges, and arenas matter. A HUD may sit in the glass.

It is not Pixel Art unless the level is also tiled. It is not FPV Drone (a real or simulated racing drone through a physical world).

It is not photoreal live action with a fake reticle slapped on. The camera must behave like a game camera.

How it works

Pick the logic: third-person follow (boom 2 to 3 meters, lag, collision), isometric 45-degree orthographic, or FPS. Keep the path readable.

Add a HUD only if the beat is play, not if it is a movie cover of a game. Motion: analog stick ease, not a film dolly's ease.

Prompt follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level.

When to use it

Use it when space must feel playable. Do not use it as a skin on a normal coverage scene, and do not reduce it to chunky pixels unless the game is pixel-art.

Compared with similar shots

Video Game is engine-like camera logic. Pixel Art is sampling.

FPV Drone is a physical flying camera through real space. Animation may render a game, or not.

If the camera dollies like a film crew and there is no follow, iso, or FPS constraint, it is not this look.

FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens.

Pixel ArtThe world is tiles.

Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.

In film

Free Guy (a life inside a game's follow-cam and HUD logic). Scott Pilgrim vs.

the World (fight space, UI, and level logic inside live action). Grammar, not frames to copy.

Prompt it

Video-game camera on [Subject], follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level, boom height locked, path readable. Name the camera type.

Do not describe a film dolly unless the game would dolly.

Use in Image Generator

Video-game camera on [Subject], follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level.

What usually goes wrong

The usual wrong cousin is Pixel Art or a film Follow Shot shot with a reticle overlay. The tell is continuous film blocking, or tiles you did not want.

Fix: lock boom height or isometric angle, make the path a level, and let the camera collide or lag like an engine.

Questions

What is Video Game in film?

A look that borrows playable camera logic: follow cam, isometric, or FPS, with space as a level and often a HUD. The lens is constrained like an engine, not like a film crew.

Video Game vs Pixel Art

Pixel art is how the image is sampled. Video-game cinematography is how the camera is allowed to move through a playable space. A game look can be 3D and continuous. Pixel art cannot hide its tiles.

When should I use Video Game?

When the beat is play: a level, a follow, a HUD, a boss arena. Skip it for a normal coverage scene with a fake overlay, for drone FPV, or for pixel tiles that are not in the brief.

How do I prompt Video Game for AI image or video?

Write: Video-game camera on [Subject], follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level. Name boom height or the 45-degree view. Do not describe a film dolly by default.

entries.title: Weirdcore
entries.text:
Weirdcore

The weirdcore aesthetic renders the familiar incorrectly: early-web compression, low-res sacred images, off-center crops, and a joke that is also a threat. The file looks like it should not have opened. Light is on-camera flash or a dim analog room, not a designed key.

Create this Weirdcore

Narrative function

A face is cut by the frame edge. A caption sits in a default font.

JPEG blocks crawl. A toy in the dark is both funny and wrong.

Resolution is a weapon. The familiar (a bedroom, a mall, a smile) is encoded badly on purpose.

It is not Dreamcore. Dreamcore is soft, spatial, analog-liminal.

Weirdcore is digital-degraded, captioned, clipart-adjacent. It is not Altered State smear.

The warp is compression and crop, not a trip.

How it works

Crush the resolution. Allow JPEG artifacts, 240p, chromatic cheapness.

Crop faces wrong. On-camera flash or underexposed analog dark.

Optional captions. Palette: Windows-era interiors, flash skin, crushed blacks.

Prompt early-web dread, low-res sacred, a joke that is also a threat.

When to use it

Use it when the familiar must look incorrectly encoded. Do not use it for a soft memory hall, for a psychedelic warp, or for polished vaporwave marble.

Compared with similar shots

Weirdcore is low-res, cropped, captioned threat. Dreamcore is a soft empty room.

Altered State smears perception. Vaporwave is pastel, marble, and tape-nostalgia without the joke-threat.

Stylistic Suck is amateur video as a film's voice. Weirdcore is specifically early-web incorrectness.

DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed.

Altered StateThe mind is the location.

Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.

In film

Skinamarink (dark analog rooms, toys, faces withheld, internet-horror adjacent). Internet horror stills and early-web images supply the native grammar.

Grammar, not frames to copy.

Prompt it

Weirdcore image of [Subject], early-web dread, low-res sacred, wrong crop, JPEG artifacts, a joke that is also a threat. Name the caption or the chopped face.

Do not polish, and do not soften into a liminal pool.

Use in Image Generator

What usually goes wrong

The usual wrong cousin is Dreamcore or Vaporwave: a soft hall, or a pink-cyan mall. The tell is continuous high-res pastel.

Fix: crush the file, crop wrong, add a cheap flash or a caption, and let the joke threaten.

Questions

What is Weirdcore in film?

A look that encodes the familiar badly: low resolution, wrong crops, captions, early-web artifacts, and a joke that is also a threat. The file is the fear.

Weirdcore vs Dreamcore

Dreamcore is analog-soft liminal space, a memory room. Weirdcore is digital-degraded and captioned. One withholds safety with empty architecture. The other withholds it with a bad encode.

When should I use Weirdcore?

When the familiar should look incorrectly rendered, as if an old file opened wrong. Skip it for soft nostalgia halls, for pastel marble, or for perception smear.

How do I prompt Weirdcore for AI image or video?
